theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → x ∈ N → ∃ (δ : ℝ) (π : Euclid P → Euclid P), 0 < δ ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 π (ball x δ) ∧ MapsTo π (ball x δ) N ∧ (∀ y ∈ N ∩ ball x δ, π y = y) ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s ≤ δ ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball x s, ∀ z ∈ ball x s, ‖π y - π z‖ ≤ (1 + η) * ‖y - z‖
